correctness.rationale: The fixed unweighted J(n,2)=L(K_n) Laplacian has eigenspaces 0, n and 2n-2 from the unsigned K_n incidence matrix, with dimensions 1,n-1,N-n. PBH forces at least N-n independent coordinate actuators. At equality, the unactuated n edges form a square unsigned incidence restriction, nonsingular precisely for odd-unicyclic components. The n-eigenspace rules out exactly two disjoint triangles at n=6; n=3,4 treated separately. The exponential formula enumerates odd-unicyclic labelled graphs, subtracting ten n=6 exceptions. Independent finite n=5,6 subset enumeration agrees with 162 and 2520, but is not the all-n proof.
